subject: Stage narratives + demo snippet packs for EdgeConf sponsorship
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@edgeconf.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Collateral & short demo snippets for EdgeConf sponsorship

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Thanks again for sponsoring EdgeConf — we’re finalizing the sponsor assets pack this week and wanted to confirm a couple of items before we publish the event microsite. Specifically: 

- One-pager: can you provide a customer-focused one-pager (PDF) that highlights a single production use case, expected latency/cost claims, and a short testimonial (1-2 lines)?
- Demo snippets: we ask for two 90-second demo scripts (one technical, one product) plus a shorter 30-45s elevator snippet we can include on the sponsor page. Plain text is fine.
- Vignette: would you be able to provide a 150-200 word customer vignette (we have a slot on the sponsor page for a short success story)?

Deadline: we need final assets by April 4 to meet print and web deadlines. Let me know if that’s tight — we can shift the placement or accept a revised file later but prefer final by EOD Apr 4.

Also, can you confirm the booth demo length — 10 or 15 minutes? That will change which snippets we pull into the live demo flow.

Thanks,
Samir
Partnerships Manager, EdgeConf
---
EdgeConf Sponsorships <sponsorships@edgeconf.com>
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@edgeconf.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-26T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Collateral & short demo snippets for EdgeConf sponsorship

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear list. We can cover everything you requested. Quick plan below and attachments (DM me if you want alternate formats):

What we’re sending (attached):
- edgeconf-onepager-v2.pdf — 1-page customer use case (Cassandra AI), two metric bullets (latency, cost delta), one-line quote from CS lead.
- demo-snippets-v3.md — contains: 90s technical script, 90s product-facing script, and two elevator snippets (30s / 45s).
- customer-vignette-cassandra-ai.docx — 180-word vignette with a pull-quote.

Booth demo length: we recommend 15 minutes to give time for Q&A and a quick walk-through of the Redwood Console telemetry. If EdgeConf is constrained to 10, we’ll prioritize the 90s product script + 3-minute live run. Please confirm which slot you’ll allocate.

Requests for you:
- Confirm placement on the site (sponsor showcase top vs. secondary card) — placement affects whether we push the technical snippet onto the main hero.
- If you want a shortened headline copy for the microsite (H1/H2), we can supply two options.

We’ll iterate quickly — Marissa will lead copy edits, Karthik will trim the demos for timing, Laura will handle the visuals for the one-pager.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachments: edgeconf-onepager-v2.pdf; demo-snippets-v3.md; customer-vignette-cassandra-ai.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@edgeconf.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Collateral & short demo snippets for EdgeConf sponsorship — edits and asks

Folks — looping you in with the assets Vivek attached. I made quick inline edits and condensed the technical demo to hit the 90s pacing; Karthik please review the timing bullets.

Top edits I applied: 
- One-pager: tightened metric bullets (reduced jargon), added a short visual cue for 'latency at scale' (callout) for the designer.
- 90s technical script: moved the architecture callouts to the end, start with problem + outcome to hook non-technical buyers.
- Vignette: replaced a paragraph with a 1-sentence punchline for better scan.

Open items for the group: 
1) Booth demo cadence — if we go 15 minutes, we should add a 3-minute live query to the product script (Karthik to add).
2) Customer quote clearance — legal needs to sign off on the Cassandra quote by Apr 6. Can we expedite? Karthik, can you ping CS?
3) Visuals — Laura, can you export one-pager as both A4 and US letter? EdgeConf indicated print support for both.

Attached: demo-snippets-v3.md (edited), edgeconf-onepager-v2.pdf (annotated for designer)

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

On Fri, Mar 26, 2027 at 10:03 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Samir — thanks for the clear list. We can cover everything you requested. Quick plan below and attachments (DM me if you want alternate formats):
>
> [snip attachments list]
From: Samir Rao <samir@edgeconf.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Nina Patel <nina@eventsagency.co>
Date: 2027-04-02T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Collateral & short demo snippets for EdgeConf sponsorship — final placement

Vivek / Marissa — this all looks great, thanks for the quick turn. Couple of final confirmations before we push to the site and print: 

- Placement: Sponsor showcase top slot confirmed (hero card) — will feature the 45s elevator snippet on hover and link to the one-pager.
- Booth demo: 15-minute slot confirmed. Please make sure the live query demo is ready (we’ll provide a wired connection and a backup laptop).
- Quote clearance: legal gave verbal sign-off for the Cassandra quote; written sign-off due Apr 5.

If you can send final PDFs (print-ready one-pager) and the final demo script (plain .md or .txt) by EOD Apr 4 we’re good to go. I’ve attached the microsite layout for reference (small PDF).

Appreciate the collaboration — excited to showcase Redwood.

Best,
Samir Rao
Partnerships Manager, EdgeConf

Attachments: edgeconf-microsite-layout.pdf
